description: List an organization's embed projects (type=embed) for viaSocket SDK setup. Each data.projects[].id is a project_id (VIASOCKET_PROJECT_ID). Reuse an existing embed: one embed serves a whole product. Only if there is none, create one with the Create Embed Project endpoint (via call_any_api) after the developer confirms.

bringflows.description: Optional. true also returns the flows of each project. e.g. false

orgId.description: Organization id from Find Organizations or Get Org Details By Token

type.description: Required. `embed` for SDK projects (`flow` and `default` are the workspace's own automation projects). e.g. embed

name: list_embed_projects
